name: Tsutsujimori Rosho
source: A former comedian and high school teacher. His subject is mathematics. In addition to his earnest and passionate personality, he cares about his students and is loved by many of them. An incident while he was performing as part of the comedy duo "Dotsuitare Hompo" caused him to develop stage fright, which led to the duo breaking up. He still gets nervous in front of people, but his sharp tsukkomi skills are still intact.
